description: CircuitDestroy semantic validity mutations (R-009 Stage 3 Phase 2 final hardening). A destroy with issuedAt > expiry is nonsensical (it was issued after it expired) and MUST be rejected at the portable verifier level (verifyCircuitDestroy), before the signature check. Domain: SHARENET/CIRCUIT/DESTROY/1.

vectors.name: issuedAt-after-expiry-rejected
vectors.description: verifyCircuitDestroy with issuedAt > expiry → semantic invalidity (the destroy was issued after it expired — nonsensical). The signature is VALID (issuedAt + expiry are both covered by the signature), but the destroy is structurally invalid.

vectors.name: issuedAt-equals-expiry-accepted
vectors.description: verifyCircuitDestroy with issuedAt == expiry (boundary) → ACCEPT (issuedAt <= expiry holds at the boundary). Confirms the check is <=, not <.

verification.notes: Mutation coverage for the issuedAt <= expiry semantic validity check (R-009 Stage 3 Phase 2 final hardening). The issuedAt-after-expiry-rejected case uses issuedAt = expiry + 1 = 1786880146 > expiry 1786880145. The signature is valid (the signer honestly signs the issuedAt + expiry pair), but the destroy is structurally invalid. The issuedAt-equals-expiry-accepted case confirms the boundary is inclusive (<=).
